newsitem.title: CHINA: MasterCard issues China co-branded card.
newsitem.headline: MasterCard issues China co-branded card.

text.p: MasterCard International Inc said on Monday it launched its first co-branded shopping card in China's capital Beijing.
The Xidan Market Group Peony MasterCard, would be issued by MasterCard, the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China and the Beijing Xidan Market Co Ltd, MasterCard said.
Holders of the card would get special discounts at Beijing's Xidan Market shopping centre, a company representative said.
MasterCard had launched co-branded purchasing cards in several cities throughout China and had issued 11 million payment cards in China as of June, the representative said.
Applicants for the co-branded Beijing card would have to have accounts with the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China.
